translations./garage/brief: Load the high-center-of-mass antenna, cross the damaged side slope, stop for a stability check, then reach the ridge relay. Speed turns steering and uneven ground into additional rollover load.
translations./prediction/heading: Is There Enough Cross-Slope Stability Margin?
translations./prediction/hint: Center-of-mass height changes the stability boundary on the same slope.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: Keep speed low and preserve margin
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Center of mass sets the static boundary. Lower speed reduces the extra load from steering and uneven ground.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: A larger motor will prevent rollover
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: A motor changes available drive force, not the rollover boundary. Lowering the center of mass or choosing a gentler slope changes that margin.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: The antenna load is reducing my stability margin. Preparing for the mid-slope check.
translations./debrief/success_summary: The debrief shows cross-slope, load motion, and rollover margin throughout the mission.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Inspect slope, transient load, and rollover risk on the timeline, then adjust the build or driving preference.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Longitudinal slope, cross-slope, body attitude, and energy use come from the same fixed-step simulation.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/collision-static: Mission failed: left the feasible region
